analysis.label: 定位
analysis.text: M: The only difference worth noting, perhaps, is that it looks like Rachel scored moderately stronger grades throughout high school and university. But as I said, only a tiny bit higher than Peter. 男：唯一也许值得一提的差别，是看起来 Rachel 在整个高中和大学的成绩略好一些。但正 如我说的，只比 Peter 高出一点点。

analysis.label: 信号
analysis.text: 明示标记 difference worth noting。男士直接说 The only difference worth noting， 与题干 worth noting 字面对应，是教科书式的答案信号；其后 Rachel scored moderately stronger grades 加上 only a tiny bit higher than Peter 就是要抓的内容。

analysis.label: 替换
analysis.text: Rachel scored moderately stronger grades throughout high school and university ↔ Rachel scored moderately higher grades than Peter at school stronger grades=higher grades，程度词原样保留 only a tiny bit higher than Peter ↔moderately higher grades than Peter a tiny bit higher印证「略高」

analysis.label: 排除
analysis.text: A) 原词陷阱 A 的 respectful and professional 直接取自女士评 Peter 的 He came across as respectful and professional，是真听到的原词；但那是夸 Peter 一人的面试表现，并非两 人都如此，且不是被点为「worth noting」的那点，属原词陷阱。 借用原文：He came across as respectful and professional C) 与原文相反 录音强调 only a tiny bit higher，仅是「略高」；C 的 excelled（出类拔萃）且说「两人 都」学业杰出，把程度从「略」拔高到「极」、把范围从「Rachel 略胜」改成「两人皆 优」，与原文程度相反。 借用原文：only a tiny bit higher than Peter D) 未提及 录音通篇比的是成绩、面试表现、成熟度，从未提到 physically（体格）；D 把 stronger 偷换成「身体上更强」，是录音根本没说的维度。

analysis.label: 定位

analysis.label: 信号
analysis.text: 条件句 If…then 的对策落点。男士用 If there's a tie, and we can't come to an agreement, then we'll take it to John 给出明确的 If…then 对策；句中专有人名 John 是 强定位信号，then 后的动作即答案。

analysis.label: 替换
analysis.text: take it to John and let him cast the deciding vote ↔Let John make the final decision cast the deciding vote=make the final decision

analysis.label: 排除
analysis.text: A) 原词陷阱 A 的 compare side by side 取自男士早前的 When comparing them side by side，确是 原词；但那是描述他们之前已做的对比，而非「谈不拢时的对策」，问的是 if can't agree 怎么办，A 时态与问点都不符。 借用原文：When comparing them side by side B) 偷换概念 B 的 cast the deciding vote 正是录音原词 cast the deciding vote，极具迷惑；但录音里 投决定票的是 John 一个人，B 却说交给 the board（董事会）投票，把「个人 John」偷换 成「集体 board」。 借用原文：take it to John and let him cast the deciding vote C) 偷换概念 C 的 break the tie 借用录音 If there's a tie 的 tie 一词，但录音对平局的对策是「这次就 交给 John」，C 却说「找办法在下次打破平局」，把「当下交 John」偷改成「留待下 次」，时点与做法都对不上。 借用原文：If there's a tie, and we can't come to an agreement

analysis.label: 替换
analysis.text: to see what creations you come up with next ↔Seeing the woman's new creations. come up with next=new creations

analysis.label: 排除
analysis.text: A) 偷换概念 录音 your underlying signature touch 里 signature 指她"标志性"的风格印记，A 却理解 成"获取她的签名"，把一词多义的 signature 偷换了义项，且男方根本没说要签名。 借用原文：your underlying signature touch C) 原词陷阱 the incorporation of indigenous aspects 是男方对本季作品已完成之处的称赞，描述的 是过去做成的事；C 盗用 indigenous 这个原词，把"已经做到"说成"他期待去做"，时间和 主体都错位。 借用原文：the incorporation of indigenous aspects D) 未提及 录音结尾的 next 是接在 what creations you come up with next（下次的作品）上的，D 借这个"下次"感造出"下次多分享想法"，可对话从没提"再聊/分享想法"，是无中生有。 Section B 1 Pet dogs can often readily understand a wide range of their owners' commands and gestures, but are these abilities inborn or are they exclusively learned through training? To find out, a new study examined whether stray dogs could understand human gestures. The study revealed that 80% of participating dogs successfully followed pointing gestures to a specific location despite having never received prior training. The results suggest that dogs can understand complex gestures by simply watching humans. This could have implications in reducing conflict between stray dogs and humans. 宠物狗往往能够轻易理解主人的各种命令和手势，但这些能力是天生的还是完全通过训练习得的？为了找 到答案，一项新研究考察了流浪狗能否理解人类手势。研究显示，80%的参与犬只成功地跟随指向手势找 到了特定位置，尽管它们此前从未接受过训练。研究结果表明，狗仅通过观察人类就能理解复杂的手势。 这可能对减少流浪狗与人类之间的冲突具有意义。 2 Dogs were domesticated 10,000 to 15,000 years ago. This means they are probably the oldest domesticated animals on the planet. Humans then bred dogs with the most desirable and useful traits so that they could function as companions and workers. This resulted in domesticated dogs that are highly responsive to human commands and gestures. However, it was not clear whether dogs understand us through training alone, or whether this was an inherent ability. Why does this matter? 狗在10,000到15,000年前被驯化。这意味着它们可能是地球上最古老的驯化动物。人类随后培育具有最 理想和最有用特征的狗，使它们能够充当伴侣和工作犬。这造就了对人类命令和手势高度敏感的驯化犬。 然而，狗是仅通过训练理解我们，还是这是一种固有能力，目前尚不清楚。为什么这很重要？ Questions 9 to 11 are based on the passage you have just heard. 3 Stray dogs are a common feature in cities around the world. They may observe and occasionally interact with people, but such dogs have never been trained, and are behaviorally "wild". Conflicts between stray dogs and humans are a problem. Understanding how humans shape stray dogs' behavior may help alleviate this problem. According to the researchers of the new study, stray dogs are intelligent creatures. They closely observe humans and use their understanding of us to make a decision. Treating stray dogs with sensitivity and respect, and giving them space, the researchers assert, can reduce much conflict. 流浪狗是世界各地城市的常见现象。它们可能观察并偶尔与人互动,但这些狗从未接受过训练，在行为上 是"野生的"。流浪狗与人类之间的冲突是个问题。理解人类如何影响流浪狗的行为可能有助于缓解这个问 题。根据这项新研究的研究人员所说，流浪狗是聪明的生物。它们密切观察人类，并利用对我们的理解来 做出决定。研究人员断言，以敏感和尊重的态度对待流浪狗，并给予它们空间，可以减少许多冲突。

analysis.label: 定位
analysis.text: The study revealed that 80% of participating dogs successfully followed pointing gestures to a specific location despite having never received prior training. 研究表明，80% 参与实验的狗在从未接受过任何训练的情况下，成功跟随指点手势找到了 特定地点。

analysis.label: 信号
analysis.text: 数字 80% 即定位锚点。录音念到 80% of participating dogs 这个数字就是定位信号，紧 跟其后的 successfully followed pointing gestures to a specific location despite having never received prior training 即承载答案的那句，听到数字就该锁定后半句。

analysis.text: A) 原词陷阱 A readily recognize their owner simply by looking 借了录音第 1 段开头 readily understand 里的 readily 一词，但录音说的是'轻易理解命令手势'，从未说'看一眼就认出主 人'，是把听到的熟词嫁接到没说过的事上。 借用原文：readily understand a wide range of their owners' commands and gestures B) 偷换概念 B understand the implications of human commands 用了录音里的 commands，但 80% 那句讲的是'跟随手势找到地点'，并非'理解命令的言外之意（implications）'； implications 一词录音另有出处（讲研究意义），被挪来制造混淆。 借用原文：This could have implications in reducing conflict C) 张冠李戴 C domesticated to act as our companions 的 domesticated、companions 都出自录音 第 2 段讲'家养狗被驯化成伴侣'，但第 9 题问的是新研究里的 80% 流浪狗，C 把'家养狗'的 事安到了'实验流浪狗'头上。 借用原文：they could function as companions and workers

The mistake we make with this is that whilst self-acceptance is imperative, it should actually be used as the basis for growth. When we're not growing, learning and seeking improvements in our lives, we tend to stagnate, accepting what is, and stop believing we can be better. 为什么我们停止为自己制定目标并停止在生活中进步?原因之一是我们相信应该接受自己本来的样子,而不 是不断努力提升自己。我们在这方面犯的错误是,虽然自我接纳至关重要,但实际上应该将其作为成长的基 Questions 22 to 25 are based on the recording you have just heard. 础。当我们不成长、不学习、不在生活中寻求改进时,我们往往会停滞不前,接受现状,并停止相信自己可以 变得更好。 2 A key tool for creating goals and progressing, is using our imagination. Instead of feeling confidence, happiness and satisfaction from achieving our goals, we feel we are always falling short. That leads to disappointment, and we stop dreaming. We stop imagining the life we'd like to have or the person we'd like to be, quickly finding ourselves shattered by the pain of our reality. 创建目标和取得进步的一个关键工具是运用我们的想象力。然而,正如常见的情况一样,到我们步入中年时, 我们已经停止梦想自己想要实现什么,并对目标设定感到相当消极。我们不再从实现目标中感受到信心、快 乐和满足,而是觉得自己总是达不到目标。这导致失望,我们停止梦想。我们停止想象自己想要拥有的生活 或想要成为的人,很快就发现自己被现实的痛苦击垮。 3 Up until now, unless we work in the creative industry, we've found the idea of using "play" a bit childish. What happens, therefore, is that we end up feeling like we're never going to reach our goals. And herein lies one of the biggest misconceptions and reasons for failure, dissatisfaction and unhappiness. We measure against the goal, rather than where we've come from. Dan Sullivan calls this "the gap and the gain". We measure always against the goal, which we never feel we're reaching, rather than the gain, that is where we've come from. In measuring where we've come from, rather than where we're trying to get to, we see results. We see things we've taken for granted, or not noticed. questions.stem: What do people tend to do when they have reached midlife?
questions.stemZh: 当人们步入中年时,他们往往会做什么?
questions.answerText: Stop imagining further progress in life.

analysis.label: 定位
analysis.text: Yet as is so often the case, by the time we've reached midlife, we've stopped dreaming about what we want to achieve and feel quite negatively about goal setting. ... We stop imagining the life we'd like to have or the person we'd like to be. 然而正如常见的那样，到我们步入中年时，我们已经不再梦想自己想要实现什么，并对设定 目标抱有相当负面的感受。……我们不再去想象自己想过的生活或想成为的人。

analysis.label: 信号
analysis.text: 转折 Yet + midlife 时间锚 + 重复 stop。Yet as is so often the case, by the time we've reached midlife 用 Yet 转折并点出时间锚 midlife，随后 we've stopped dreaming 与 We stop imagining the life we'd like to have 两次出现 stop，反复强调的负向行为正是 答案落点。

analysis.label: 替换
analysis.text: We stop imagining the life we'd like to have or the person we'd like to be ↔ Stop imagining further progress in life. stop imagining 原词 + 概括化 we've stopped dreaming about what we want to achieve ↔ Stop imagining further progress in life. stop dreaming = stop imagining progress

analysis.label: 排除
analysis.text: A) 与原文相反 Feel confidence, happiness and satisfaction. 三个词全部来自原文 Instead of feeling confidence, happiness and satisfaction from achieving our goals，但原文前面是 Instead of（而不是），意思恰恰是人们没有这些感受，选项却取了被否定的内容，是典型 听到原词就选的陷阱。 借用原文：Instead of feeling confidence, happiness and satisfaction from achieving our goals B) 与原文相反 Believe they have achieved their life goals. 说人们相信已达成人生目标，而原文说中年 时人们 feel we are always falling short（总觉得没达到），方向完全相反，属无中生有又 反向。 借用原文：we feel we are always falling short C) 张冠李戴 Use a key tool for setting ambitious goals. 里 a key tool 来自第 2 段开头 A key tool for creating goals and progressing, is using our imagination，但那是作者讲『工具是 什么』，并非说中年人会去用它；原文恰恰说中年时人们停止了想象，选项张冠李戴。 借用原文：A key tool for creating goals and progressing, is using our imagination

questions.stem: Why do we find ourselves irritated for not achieving the goal?
questions.stemZh: 为什么我们会因未能达成目标而感到恼怒?
questions.answerText: We have to adapt to the ever-changing goal.

analysis.label: 定位
analysis.text: The problem with finding ourselves irritated for not achieving the goal is because the goal always changes and we're always adapting, whether we realize it or not. 我们因没达成目标而恼火，问题在于：目标总在变化，而无论我们是否意识到，我们也总在 不断适应。

analysis.label: 信号
analysis.text: 因果结构 The problem with … is because。The problem with finding ourselves irritated for not achieving the goal is because the goal always changes 用 The problem … is because 直接给出原因，because 后的 the goal always changes and we're always adapting 就是答案句核心。

analysis.label: 替换
analysis.text: the goal always changes and we're always adapting ↔ We have to adapt to the ever-changing goal. always changes + always adapting → ever-changing + adapt

analysis.label: 排除
analysis.text: A) 偷换概念 We feel we are always falling behind others. 借了原文反复出现的 always 与 falling 的 语感（如 we feel we are always falling short），但加了 others（落后于他人）。原文讲 的是和自己的目标比、和来路比，从未说和别人比，others 是凭空添加。 借用原文：we feel we are always falling short C) 原词陷阱 There are various misconceptions about goal setting. 搬用了原文 herein lies one of the biggest misconceptions 的 misconceptions，听着耳熟，但题目问的是『恼火的原 因』，原因是 the goal always changes，而非泛泛地说『存在各种误解』，属听到原词就 选的陷阱。 借用原文：herein lies one of the biggest misconceptions D) 偷换概念 There are always problems with the goal originally set. 借了原文 The problem with… 的 problem 一词，但原文说的是『恼火这件事的问题在于目标在变』，不是说『当初设的 目标本身有毛病』，把问题归错了对象。 借用原文：The problem with finding ourselves irritated for not achieving the goal

questions.stem: What does the speaker say has an immediate positive impact on our thinking?
questions.stemZh: 讲话者说什么对我们的思维有立即的积极影响?
questions.answerText: Measuring where we've come from instead of measuring against the goal.

analysis.label: 定位
analysis.text: We measure against the goal, rather than where we've come from. ... In measuring where we've come from, rather than where we're trying to get to, we see results. ... It's a simple, yet profound change in perception ... yet has an immediate, positive impact on our thinking. 我们对着目标来衡量，而不是衡量自己走过了多远。……当我们衡量自己走过了多远、而非 衡量离要去的地方还差多少时，我们就看到了成果。……这是一种简单却深刻的认知转变…… 却对我们的思维有着即时而正面的影响。

analysis.label: 信号
analysis.text: 正面评价 profound/positive impact 指向 measuring where we've come from。has an immediate, positive impact on our thinking 这句的『它』回指前文反复强调的 In measuring where we've come from, rather than where we're trying to get to，作者用 profound、positive impact 正面定性的正是这种衡量来路的做法。

analysis.label: 替换
analysis.text: measuring where we've come from, rather than where we're trying to get to ↔ Measuring where we've come from instead of measuring against the goal. rather than = instead of，goal = where we're trying to get to

analysis.label: 排除
analysis.text: A) 未提及 A noticeable change in the number of goals to achieve. 说『要达成的目标数量发生明 显变化』，原文谈的是衡量基准的转变（量来路 vs 量目标），从未提目标的数量变化，属 未提及。 B) 与原文相反 Measuring always against the gap rather than the gain. 搬用了原文术语 We measure always against the goal 与 gap/gain，但作者批评的恰恰是『总对着 gap/goal 量』、推 崇的是量 gain（来路）。选项说『量 gap 而非 gain』正好取了被否定的一面，与原文相 反。 借用原文：We measure always against the goal D) 偷换概念 A proper conception of what we fail to notice in trying to achieve our goals. 借了原 文 things we've taken for granted, or not noticed 的 not noticed，拼成『对我们没注意 到之物的正确认知』，但原文说有即时正面影响的是『衡量来路这一做法』本身，不是某种 conception，属偷换概念/过度拼凑。 借用原文：things we've taken for granted, or not noticed The only difference worth noting, perhaps, is that it looks like Rachel scored moderately stronger grades throughout high school and university. 第4段，第2句 主系表 + 表语从句 + 嵌套宾语从句是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式，"looks like"引宾语从句也 是常见表达。句中插入语、后置定语、比较级修饰都是真题常考结构，掌握后可大量复用到类似长 难句分析中。 In addition, Rachel interviewed very well. 第5段，第3句 简单句中带连接副词和方式状语的组合在真题中常见,但本句过于简短,缺少定语从句、复杂状语等 高频考点结构,代表性一般。 I thought she came across as bright and alert. 第5段，第4句 think 后接省略 that 的宾语从句是四六级和考研高频句式,从句内的系动词短语 came across 也是常 考表达,整体结构具有较高代表性和复用价值 She asked some very good questions about the position and the company, which made me think she is very keen about the job. 第6段，第2句 非限制性定语从句补充说明主句、宾语从句作think的宾语、make sb do结构，这些都是四六级和 考研真题中高频出现的句式。句子结构具有较强的代表性，掌握后可迁移到大量类似句型。 He came across as respectful and professional, wouldn't you say? 第7段，第4句 陈述句 + 附加反问(tag question)的组合在口语和书面语中都较常见，具有一定典型性，但两个主 句都相对简短，不属于考试中高频出现的长难句结构。 So, we agree that Rachel appeared inexperienced and less mature than Peter, even though both candidates are the same age and have practically no work experience. 第9段，第2句 本句的结构具有较强的代表性：主句 + 宾语从句 + 让步状语从句的组合，在四六级和考研真题中 非常常见。宾语从句由 that 引导，让步状语从句由 even though 引导，都是高频考点。句中还包 含比较结构和并列谓语，这些都是真题中反复出现的句式特征。掌握这类结构后，学生可以迁移到 大量类似的复杂句分析中，实用价值较高。 To be honest, I think I like Rachel better. 第12段，第3句 "I think + 宾语从句" 是四六级和考研阅读中极为常见的表达观点句式,省略 that 的用法也频繁出 现。掌握此结构可直接迁移到大量类似句子,典型性较高。 If there's a tie, and we can't come to an agreement, then we'll take it to John and let him cast the deciding vote. 第14段，第2句 条件状语从句加主句是四六级和考研中极为常见的句式，"If...then..."结构高度典型。主句中并列谓 语、使役动词、方向状语等也是常考结构。掌握本句的分析方法可以直接迁移到大量真题句型中， 代表性强。 Why does the man think it is difficult to make the decision? 第1题题干 疑问句加宾语从句的结构在四六级和考研阅读理解中频繁出现，尤其是 think、believe、suppose 等动词后省略 that 的用法非常常见。形式主语 it 加不定式的结构也是典型的书面表达句式。掌握 本句的分析方法可以迁移到大量类似句子，具有较高的代表性。 Both candidates are very keen on getting the job. 第1题，B 主系表结构是英语中最常见的基本句型之一，掌握后可迁移到大量描述状态或特征的句子。但本句 过于简单，四六级和考研真题中更常出现带有从句修饰或复杂定语的主系表结构，本句的代表性中 等偏下。 What do the speakers say may be worth noting? 第2题题干 疑问句 + 宾语从句（省略 that）+ 疑问词在从句中充当成分，是四六级听力和考研阅读中的高频 句式。掌握该结构可直接迁移到大量真题中的疑问句和宾语从句分析，典型性强。 Both Rachel and Peter came across as respectful and professional. 第2题，A "主语 + 系动词短语 + 表语" 的结构在考试中较为常见，"Both ... and ..." 并列主语和 "came across as" 系动词用法也是典型考点，具有较好的代表性。 Both Rachel and Peter excelled in their academic pursuit. 第2题，C "Both ... and ..." 并列主语 + 不及物动词 + 介词短语状语是常见句式，在四六级和考研阅读中经常 出现，具有一定代表性。但本句过于简单，缺少从句、复杂修饰等真题中更高频的结构特征，典型 性中等。 According to the man, what might account for Peter appearing somewhat more self-assured than Rachel? 第3题题干 本句涵盖疑问句倒装、情态动词作谓语、疑问词作主语、复合宾语（名词 + 现在分词）、介词短 语作状语、比较结构省略等多种成分和结构；宾语中的"Peter appearing"是容易误判的坑点（可能 被误认为独立谓语或从句）；作为成分划分练习句，能够覆盖较丰富的知识点和常见易错点，训练 价值较高。 I try not to adhere to social norms and expectations. 第2段，第2句 本句的 "try (not) to do" 结构是四六级和考研常考的动词 + 不定式搭配，具有一定代表性。但整体 为简单句，没有从句或复杂修饰成分，不如主从复合句那样典型。掌握后可迁移到类似的 "decide/plan/hope to do" 等结构，但复用范围有限。 I couldn't stop thinking about it. 第4段，第3句 "情态动词 + 动词原形 + 动名词宾语" 结构在四六级、考研阅读中较为常见，属于日常表达心理状 态的典型句式，掌握后有一定迁移性，但不属于高频复杂句式，代表性中等。 Trying to recreate their designs would have been futile. 第4段，第4句 本句覆盖动名词短语作主语、系动词完成式作谓语、形容词作表语三种核心成分，且主语内部嵌套 不定式短语，能够训练学生识别非谓语动词结构、区分动名词与不定式的句法功能、理解系表结 构。主语部分的动名词短语是常考易错点，具有较高练习价值。 So instead, I applied my own eccentric approach. 第4段，第5句 主谓宾加状语的简单句结构在各类考试中很常见，具有一定代表性。句首用 "So" 和 "instead" 承接 上文也是典型的语篇衔接手段。但由于句式过于简单，缺少复合句、长难句等考试中更高频的结构 特征，代表性中等偏下。 Using glitter, I drew similar intricate patterns onto the velvet cape. 第4段，第6句 分词短语作状语位于句首、主句为主谓宾加介词短语状语的结构，是四六级和考研真题中的高频句 式。这种 "分词短语 + 逗号 + 主句" 的模式在阅读理解和翻译题中反复出现，掌握后迁移价值高。 唯一不足是本句为简单句，未涉及从句，但作为状语识别的典型例句代表性强。 M: It was indeed majestic, and yet, dare I say, masculine at the same time. 第5段，第1句 覆盖主系表结构、并列表语、插入语和状语，成分种类中等，插入语的识别对初学者有一定训练价 值，但整体结构偏简单，缺少宾语、定语从句等常见易错点 Hence, the sparkling cape was paired with a traditional power suit you would typically see in a business setting. 第6段，第3句 被动语态加省略关系代词的限制性定语从句是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式,学习者掌握后可应 用于大量类似结构,迁移性强 It was sensational, if I do say so myself. 第6段，第4句 条件状语从句在考试中常见,但本句的 if 从句属于插入性评论而非真正条件,这种用法相对少见。主 句的主系表结构虽典型,但全句作为整体的代表性一般,学了之后迁移场景有限。 You have proven yourself a formidable young designer, and we can't wait to see what creations you come up with next. 第7段，第4句 第一个主句涵盖宾语补足语（"a formidable young designer"）与双宾语倾向结构,对区分宾语补 足语与直接宾语有训练价值。第二个主句包含不定式作宾语和嵌套宾语从句,宾语从句中 "what" 兼 任引导词和定语成分,成分丰富。时间状语 "next" 位置常规但需识别。覆盖多种易错点,训练价值 较高。 Make velvet capes look both majestic and masculine. 第7题，C 本句覆盖了祈使句的主语省略、使役动词 make 的宾语和宾语补足语结构、形容词并列 （both...and...）等成分，具有一定的练习价值。尤其宾语补足语的识别（动词原形 look 作补语） 是学习者易混淆的点，适合训练。 What is the man looking forward to? 第8题题干 特殊疑问句的倒装结构和疑问词充当宾语的用法在四六级和考研真题中非常常见,"What is ... doing" 和 "look forward to" 都是高频句式和短语,掌握本句的分析方法可以直接迁移到大量类似句子上,具 有较高的典型性 To find out, a new study examined whether stray dogs could understand human gestures. 第1段，第2句 主句加宾语从句是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式,whether 引导的名词性从句尤其常见。句首不定 式作目的状语也是典型用法。掌握此句结构后可直接迁移到大量类似长难句 The results suggest that dogs can understand complex gestures by simply watching humans. 第1段，第4句 "主句 + 宾语从句" 是四六级和考研阅读中高频出现的句式，suggest、show、indicate 等动词后接 that 从句的结构极为常见。本句结构简洁规范，是该句式的典型代表，掌握后可广泛迁移到类似句 子的分析。 Humans then bred dogs with the most desirable and useful traits so that they could function as companions and workers. 第2段，第3句 主句加 so that 引导的目的状语从句是四六级和考研阅读中高频出现的句式，情态动词 could 表示 能力或可能性也是常考点，掌握此结构后可迁移至大量类似句子，具有较高的典型性。 This resulted in domesticated dogs that are highly responsive to human commands and gestures. 第2段，第4句 主句加限制性定语从句修饰宾语的结构在四六级和考研阅读中非常常见，属于典型的复杂句型。掌 握这种结构后可迁移到大量类似句子的分析中。 However, it was not clear whether dogs understand us through training alone, or whether this was an inherent ability. 第2段，第5句 “It is clear/doubtful whether...” 这种句式在四六级和考研阅读中极高频出现，是学习从句平衡原则 的代表性句式。 According to the researchers of the new study, stray dogs are intelligent creatures. 第3段，第5句 主系表结构配介词短语状语是常见句式，在四六级阅读和写作中频繁出现，具备一定代表性。但本 句过于简单，缺少从句或复杂修饰，无法覆盖考试中常考的嵌套或并列结构，典型性中等。 What do the researchers suggest we do to reduce conflicts between stray dogs and humans? 第11题题干 疑问句 + 宾语从句是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式,suggest后接虚拟语气宾语从句也是常考语法 点。本句结构清晰规整,没有生僻特例,学习者掌握后可以迁移到大量类似的 suggest/advise/recommend等动词的疑问句中,典型性很高。 Watch their behavior and try to improve it. 第11题，D 祈使句 + 并列谓语是常见句式，在应用文、说明文中频繁出现，具有一定代表性；但考试阅读理 解中更常考复杂陈述句和从句结构，祈使句通常不是重点考查对象，典型性中等偏下。 As a result, refrigerators are typically set at or below that low end to protect foods against bacteria. 第2段，第2句 "主语 + be + 过去分词 + 状语 + 不定式目的状语" 是四六级和考研阅读中高频出现的句式,被动语 态表达客观事实、不定式表目的的搭配非常典型,学习后可迁移到大量类似句子 The top area is not as cold as the bottom of the fridge, so save it for the foods that don't need extra-chilly A) As the scale and impacts of climate change become increasingly alarming, meat is a popular target for action. Advocates for the protection of the natural environment from destruction or pollution urge the public to eat less meat. Some activists have even called for taxing meat to reduce consumption of it.
B) A key claim underlying these arguments holds that globally, meat production generates more greenhouse gases than the entire transportation sector. However, this claim is demonstrably wrong, as I will show. And its persistence has led to false assumptions about the linkage between meat and climate change.
C) My recent research focuses on ways in which animal agriculture affects air quality and climate change. In my view, there are many reasons for either choosing animal protein or opting for a vegetarian selection. However, abandoning meat and meat products is not the environmental panacea( 万灵药) many would have us believe. And if taken to an extreme, it also could have harmful nutritional consequences.
D) A healthy portion of meat's negative reputation centers on the assertion that livestock is the largest source of greenhouse gases worldwide. For example, an analysis published in 2009 by the World Watch Institute based in Washington, D.C. asserted that 51 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions come from rearing and processing livestock. According to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, the largest sources of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions in 2016 were electricity production (28 percent of total emissions), transportation (28 percent) and industry (22 percent). All of agriculture accounted for a total of 9 percent, but all of animal agriculture contributes less than half of this amount, representing 3.9 percent of the total greenhouse emission in the U.S. That is very different from claiming that livestock represents as much as or more than transportation.
E) Why is there such a misconception? In 2006 the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) published a study titled "Livestock's Long Shadow," which received widespread international attention. It stated that livestock produced a staggering 18 percent of the world's greenhouse gas emissions. The agency drew a startling conclusion that livestock was doing more to harm the climate than all modes of transportation combined. This latter claim was wrong, and has since been corrected by Henning Stenfeld, the report's senior author.
F) The problem was that analysts from the FAO used a comprehensive life-cycle assessment to study the climate impact of livestock, but a different method when they analyzed transportation. For livestock, they considered every factor associated with producing meat. This included emissions from fertilizer production, converting land from forests to pastures, growing feed, and direct emissions from animals (manure as well as expelling of gas from the stomach) from birth to death.
G) However, when they looked at transportation's carbon footprint, they ignored impacts on the climate from manufacturing vehicle materials and parts, assembling vehicles and maintaining roads, bridges and airports. Instead, they only considered the exhaust smoke emitted by finished cars, trucks, trains and planes. As a result, the FAO's comparison of greenhouse gas emissions from livestock to those from transportation was greatly distorted.
H) I pointed out this flaw during a speech to fellow scientists in San Francisco on March 22, 2010, which led to a flood of media coverage. To its credit, the FAO immediately owned up to its error. Unfortunately, the agency's initial claim that livestock was responsible for the lion's share of world greenhouse gas emissions had already received wide coverage. The motherhood penalty has become a shorthand for describing why: In many places, especially rich countries, women earn the same as men until they reach their childbearing years. P1 Why are we so worried about our careers? Partly it's to do with money, but there's a psychological aspect to our fears as well.

P2 We worry because we suspect—not wrongly—that the world is full of a frightening sort of person ready to judge us ruthlessly and swiftly: a person we can call a snob.

P3 A snob is anyone who takes a relatively small part of us and uses it to come to a rigid conclusion about how much of their attention we deserve. In the past, that might be your ancestry and royal connections. Nowadays, the snob cares about one thing only: what you do for a living.

P4 This explains why the first question we will be asked in any new social context is 'What do you do?' and according to how we answer, snobs will either welcome us with broad smiles, or leave us in the cold. Questions 46 to 50 are based on the following passage.

P5 And that is why we are fired up by such a desperate urge to achieve and impress.

P6 Sometimes our behaviour is mistaken for greed and vanity, but it is more than this. A lot of our interest in fancy cars, jobs and houses has nothing to do with materialism. It has to do with a hunger for the respect and esteem that is only available in our societies through the acquisition of material goods. It isn't the goods themselves we seek, it is the love we stand to gain through our possession of them. The next time we see someone driving a Ferrari, we shouldn't condemn them for their greed, we should pity them for the intensity of their need for love from the world.

P7 At the root of snobbery is a lack of imagination and confidence about how to decide who in the world is valuable. The snobs are brutally misguided and slavish in their beliefs about how the superior individuals can be identified. For snobs, it is the already acclaimed and already successful who are the only ones worthy of respect. There is no room in their timid regimented minds to imagine that someone might be clever, kind or good—and yet somehow have been overlooked entirely by society, their qualities lying hidden beneath an unfamiliar veil, and having as yet discovered no obvious outlet.

P8 The true answer to snobbery is not to say that there is no such thing as a better or worse person, but to insist that better or worse exist in constantly unexpected places and carry none of the outward signs of distinction. And because we are such poor judges of the worth of others, our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path. 46. What gives rise to our worry about careers apart from money? A) Fear of being judged in a snobbish manner. B) The prospect of facing fault-finding managers. C) The ruthless way employees are often treated. D) Fright at the difficulty in hunting for a job.

Platforms such as WeChat and Weibo have become part of daily life, yet the way we behave online shapes both our own reputation and the wider community. To use social media responsibly, we should verify information before sharing it and treat others with respect. This is because a single careless post can spread misinformation within minutes. A case in point is my own experience: last year I nearly forwarded a false rumour about a campus event, but a quick check revealed it was fake. Had I shared it, I would have misled hundreds of classmates. Therefore, using social media properly is not a trivial habit but a genuine responsibility. sentences.text: 时态 回指全篇基调，陈述既有优势，用一般现在时 boasts。 主谓一致 主语 the Greater Bay Area 是单数，谓语用第三人称单数 boasts/has，注意词尾 -s 不要漏。 单复数与冠词 infrastructure（基础设施）、resources 中 infrastructure 不可数、不加 a、不加 -s；resources 可数且泛指多种，用复数；location 可数、泛指一处用 a favorable location。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area boasts a favorable geographical location, well-developed transport infrastructure and abundant industrial resources. 2. 大湾区是中国开放程度最高、经济活力最强的区域之一,在国家经济发展中具有重要的战略 地位。

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 大湾区作主语，主系表 is one of … regions 立骨架（主语策略：原句主语） 主语仍是 大湾区。句子前半 是中国开放程度最高、经济活力最强的区域之一 是「A 是 B 之一」的 判断句，主干用系动词 is + one of the … regions；后半 在国家经济发展中具有重要的战略地位 另起一个动作，可降级处理而非新立一句。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: 两个最高级并列作定语，后半句降级为 and 引导的并列谓语 开放程度最高、经济活力最强 译成两个并列最高级定语 the most open and economically dynamic；在国家经济发展中具有重要的战略地位 与前半同主语，降级为 and 连接的并列谓语 and holds an important strategic position in …，不必重复主语另起一句。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 最高级结构 「最……之一」固定译为 one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词：one of the most open … regions， the 不可省、regions 必须复数。 单复数 「区域之一」意味着存在多个区域，one of 后的名词 regions 必须用复数，这是最高频失分点。 时态 陈述现状的地位，回指基调用一般现在时 is / holds。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: As one of the most open and economically dynamic regions in China, the Greater Bay Area holds an important strategic position in the country's economic development. 3. 大湾区不仅将建成充满活力的世界级城市群和具有全球影响力的国际科技创新中心,还将打造 成适合工作、购物、旅游的优质生活圈。

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 大湾区是「被建成」的承受者，用 will be built into 被动（主语策略：转被动） 中文 大湾区不仅将建成……还将打造成…… 的「建成/打造成」其实是「(大湾区)被建设成」，承受 者是大湾区。英文用被动把承受者提作主语：the Greater Bay Area will not only be built into … but also be turned into …，比生硬补一个主语 we 更客观、更合介绍语体。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: not only … but also 框定两层将来规划，长定语用后置/介词短语 不仅……还…… 用关联词 not only … but also 框住两个并列将来动作。两个宾语的长修饰降级安 放：充满活力的世界级城市群→a dynamic world-class city cluster；具有全球影响力的国际科技 创新中心→an international center for sci-tech innovation with global influence，「具有全球 影响力」用 with 介词短语后置；适合工作、购物、旅游的优质生活圈→a quality living circle suitable for working, shopping and traveling，「适合……的」用 suitable for + 动名词后置。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 「将建成/将打造成」是未来规划，偏离基调，用一般将来时 will be built/turned into。 关联词搭配 not only … but also 须成对出现、后接结构对称：be built into … 与 (be) turned into … 两个被 动结构平行。 动名词并列 「适合工作、购物、旅游」三项作 for 的宾语须用动名词并列 working, shopping and traveling，词性一致、形式平行。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: The Greater Bay Area will not only be built into a dynamic world-class city cluster and an international center for sci-tech innovation with global influence, but also be turned into a quality living circle suitable for working, shopping and traveling. 4. 随着改革开放的不断深入,大湾区的建设将进一步推动区域经济发展。

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 「大湾区的建设」作主语，promote 作谓语推动「区域经济发展」（主语策略：原句主语） 主干取自 大湾区的建设将进一步推动区域经济发展：主语是 the construction of the Greater Bay Area，谓语 will further promote，宾语 regional economic development。句首 随着改革开放 的不断深入 是背景状语，不入主干。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: 「随着……深入」译为 With 介词短语作状语前置 随着改革开放的不断深入 降级为伴随状语，用 With the deepening of the reform and opening-up 这一介词短语前置，「不断深入」化为名词 deepening，避免另起从句。主干其余部 分本就是简单的主谓宾，无需再降级。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 「将进一步推动」是未来趋势，用一般将来时 will further promote。 冠词 the construction of …、the deepening of the reform and opening-up，特指此地此事用定冠 词 the；reform and opening-up 作固定术语前加 the。 单复数 regional economic development（区域经济发展）作抽象不可数名词，不加 -s、不加 a。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: With the deepening of the reform and opening-up, the construction of the Greater Bay Area will further promote regional economic development. 5. 到2035年,大湾区将实现成为国际一流湾区的目标。

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 大湾区作主语，achieve 作谓语，宾语是「目标」（主语策略：原句主语） 主语是 大湾区，谓语取 将实现……目标 的「实现」译 achieve，宾语是 its goal。到2035年 是时 间状语，成为国际一流湾区 是「目标」的具体内容，作 goal 的同位修饰。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: 「成为国际一流湾区」用 of + 动名词作 goal 的同位语，年份状语前置 成为国际一流湾区 是目标的内容，降级为 the goal of becoming a world-class bay area，用 of + 动名词承接；到2035年 译为 By 2035 时间状语置于句首。整句主干简洁，无需从句。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 「到2035年将实现」是对未来某时点的预期，用一般将来时 will achieve；By 2035 与 will 搭配自 然。 时间状语介词 「到2035年」表「在2035年之前完成」用 By 2035，不用 In 2035（In 仅表「在2035这一年 内」，与「实现目标」的截止含义不符）。 冠词 its goal 用物主代词 its 承接大湾区，避免重复；a world-class bay area 泛指一类用不定冠词 a。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: By 2035, the Greater Bay Area will achieve its goal of becoming a world-class bay area. 英语六级 2025年6月·第2套 · 全卷构成 Part III Part III Part III Part III
